div.head: Before the Evangel written by MATTHEW, a Title is prefixed, common to it, and all the rest of the Writings of the Apostles and Evangelists, which is this: THE NEW TESTAMENT (Or COVENANT) OF OUR LORD AND SAVIOUR JESUS CHRIST.
div.p: THe whole Bible is commonly called by the name of Old and New Testament, or Covenant

div.head: The speciall Title prefixed to this Evangel, is, THE GOSPEL By, or According to MATTHEW.
div.p: THis Book is called the Gospel or glad Tidings, because the doctrine contained in it concerning our redemption from sin and misery, by Christ the Son of God,

q.p: Ver. 5. Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the Sabbath-dayes the Priests in the Temple profane the Sabbath, and are blamelesse?
6. But I say unto you, that in this place there is one greater then the temple.

div.p: The second reason, is, The priests for promoving of the service of the Temple, do bodily work on the sabbath, which in your language is to profane the sabbath,
div.q: Ver. 7. But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltlesse.
div.p: The third reason, is this, The Lord never appointed the outward ceremonies of his service in the first table, to hinder works of mercy prescribed in the second
